title: Hey there, I’m Ford!
text:
Hey there, I’m Ford!

I’m a data analyst and storyteller who specializes in uncovering insights from web analytics and big data. With a background in sociology and criminology, I’ve always been drawn to understanding patterns and turning them into meaningful, engaging narratives.
Learning R sparked my love for transforming raw data into relatable stories and creating custom visuals that make complex information accessible. Whether it’s diving into web metrics or building visuals, I thrive on blending creativity with analysis.
Outside the world of data, you’ll usually find me exploring hiking trails, capturing moments through my camera, or perfecting my golf swing.
Take a look around my site to see my projects and how I bring data to life!
